title: How the Internet Connects Us
description: A short three-scene motion-graphics explainer demonstrating data-driven video projects.

scenes.title: The Internet Connects Us
scenes.body: Every message, page, and video starts with a connection.

scenes.title: How information travels
scenes.body: Your device sends a request through networks to a server. The server responds, and the information travels back to you.

scenes.title: A world of possibilities
scenes.body: That is the internet: billions of connected devices sharing information.
